get.summary: Returns the Host-resolved tenant snapshot.
get.description:
Exposes TenantContext after TenantResolutionMiddleware.
Unresolved Host → 404. Not a trust source for clients — diagnostic only.

200.description: Tenant id and slug for the current request.

404.description: Tenant could not be resolved from Host/path.

get.summary: Returns the application version.
get.description: Informational version of the current Clavi.Server assembly.

post.summary: Provisions a tenant with admin and default SPA client.
post.description:
Requires header X-Clavi-Tenant-Factory-Key when Auth:TenantFactory:ApiKey is set.
Host must resolve (e.g. clavi.clavi.local). New Host is {slug}.{BaseDomain}.

401.description: Factory key missing/invalid or factory disabled.

delete.summary: Revokes a role from a user in the Host-resolved tenant.
delete.description:
Missing assignment or cross-tenant ids → 404. Idempotent revoke of a missing link is not silent —
clients must treat 404 as already-absent.

404.description: Assignment missing or belongs to another tenant.

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes traceId when configured.

post.summary: Assigns a role to a user in the Host-resolved tenant.
post.description:
Both user and role must belong to the current tenant. Duplicate assign → 409 role_already_assigned.
Cross-tenant ids look like missing (404).

404.description: User or role missing or belongs to another tenant.

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes traceId when configured.

get.summary: Lists roles assigned to a user in the Host-resolved tenant.
get.description: Missing or cross-tenant user → 404. Empty list means the user has no roles yet.

404.description: User missing or belongs to another tenant.

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes traceId when configured.

get.summary: Lists users of the Host-resolved tenant (paged).
get.description:
Query: page, page_size, search, state (active|disabled|locked|pending_verification).
Returns only users belonging to the current tenant.

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes traceId when configured.

post.summary: Creates a user in the Host-resolved tenant.
post.description:
Tenant comes from Host/path only — never from the body.
Username is unique per tenant. Password is hashed with Argon2id; plaintext is never stored.
Password is checked against HIBP (k-anonymity) with local fallback before hashing (G-AUTH-12/13).

400.description: Validation failed or tenant not resolved.

409.description: username_taken: username already exists in this tenant.

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes traceId when configured.

get.summary: Gets a user by id in the Host-resolved tenant.
get.description: Cross-tenant ids are indistinguishable from missing — both return 404 (BOLA as not-found).

404.description: User missing or belongs to another tenant.

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes traceId when configured.

patch.summary: Patches tenant name and/or lifecycle state.
patch.description:
Suspended/locked tenants are removed from the Host resolve map immediately.
Reactivating publishes the slug again.

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes traceId when configured.

get.summary: Gets one tenant by catalog id.

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes traceId when configured.

get.summary: Lists tenants in the global catalog (paged).
get.description: Query: page, page_size, search (name/slug).

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes traceId when configured.

post.summary: Creates a tenant in the global catalog.
post.description:
System-admin surface. Slug becomes Host-resolvable immediately when state is active.
Optional config seeds password/session/MFA defaults; omitted fields use TenantConfig defaults.

400.description: Validation failed or Host tenant not resolved.

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes traceId when configured.

put.summary: Replaces password / lockout / session / MFA config for a tenant.
put.description: Omitted sections keep TenantConfig defaults; this is a full document replace.

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes traceId when configured.

get.summary: Gets password / lockout / session / MFA config for a tenant.

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes traceId when configured.

put.summary: Replaces the current tenant session policy.
put.description: Login issues BFF sessions with AbsoluteTimeoutHours from this policy.

get.summary: Gets the current tenant session policy.

put.summary: Replaces the current tenant password policy.
put.description: Login/reset paths enforce minLength, character classes, and BreachCheckEnabled.

get.summary: Gets the current tenant password policy.

put.summary: Replaces the current tenant lockout policy.
put.description: Login throttle uses MaxAttempts / LockoutDurationMinutes / ResetAttemptsAfterMinutes.

get.summary: Gets the current tenant lockout policy.

post.summary: Checks a password against breach corpora (HIBP + local).
post.description: Same capability as POST /auth/check-breach; A17 surface for admin UI.

get.summary: Returns the latest isolation attestation for the Host tenant.
get.description: Optional query reportId selects a specific stored report.

post.summary: Runs BOLA/Host isolation probes against a peer tenant.
post.description:
Creates an ephemeral marker user in the Host tenant, verifies the peer cannot read it
via QF/RLS, optionally probes cookie Host portability, and returns a signed report.

get.summary: Lists roles of the Host-resolved tenant.
get.description:
Returns the tenant role catalog. Ensures the seeded system role tenant_admin exists.
No cross-tenant bleed.

200.description: Tenant role list (includes seeded system roles).

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes traceId when configured.

delete.summary: Revokes all sessions except the current one.
delete.description: Keeps the request session alive. Also revokes all OIDC refresh tokens for the user.

get.summary: Lists the current user's active sessions (paged).
get.description:
Authoritative read (no cache). Marks the request session with isCurrent.
Query: page, page_size.
MVP omits ipAddress/userAgent — columns deferred to Target schema.

delete.summary: Revokes one session owned by the current user.
delete.description:
Other-user session ids → 404 (BOLA as not-found).
Also revokes all OIDC refresh tokens for the user (no session↔family link in MVP).

404.description: Session missing or not owned by caller.

get.summary: Returns the current user's profile.
get.description:
Requires a live BFF session cookie. Anonymous → 401.
Includes role names and admin SPA nav keys derived from Auth:AdminAuthz.

delete.summary: Requests account deletion with a cooling-off period.

post.summary: Cancels a pending account deletion request.
post.description: Clears deletion_scheduled_for so login works again. Requires an active cooling-off request.

post.summary: Complete passkey registration (not implemented in MVP).
post.description: Returns 501 auth.mfa.webauthn_not_implemented. Does not persist credentials.

post.summary: Begin passkey registration (not implemented in MVP).
post.description:
Returns 501 auth.mfa.webauthn_not_implemented. Passkeys are deferred;
Community MFA is TOTP + recovery codes (G-AUTH-10/11). See GAPS-MVP.md.

delete.summary: Delete a passkey (not implemented in MVP).
delete.description:
Returns 501 auth.mfa.webauthn_not_implemented. Path parameter is accepted
for OpenAPI shape only — no credential store exists yet.

post.summary: Verifies a TOTP code for the authenticated user.
post.description:
Requires enrolled TOTP. Same time-step reused → 401 auth.mfa.replay (G-AUTH-10).
Counter is stored in PostgreSQL, not cache.

post.summary: Starts TOTP enrollment for the authenticated user.
post.description:
Requires a live BFF session. Returns Base32 secret and otpauth URI once.
Confirmed TOTP already present → 409 auth.mfa.already_enrolled.

200.description: Pending setup created; secret returned once.

post.summary: Confirms TOTP enrollment with the first authenticator code.
post.description:
Burns the matched time-step into last_used_counter (G-AUTH-10).
Sets users.mfa_enabled and returns 10 recovery codes once (G-AUTH-11).

200.description: TOTP enrolled; recovery codes returned once.

get.summary: Shows how many unused recovery codes remain.
get.description: Does not reveal plaintext codes. Requires MFA enrolled (G-AUTH-11).

post.summary: Regenerates MFA recovery codes.
post.description:
Burns all unused codes, then returns 10 new plaintext codes once (G-AUTH-11 / S5.10).
Previous unused codes become invalid immediately.

post.summary: Consumes one MFA recovery code.
post.description:
Single-use burn via atomic used_at (G-AUTH-11). Re-presenting the same code fails.
Login-challenge wiring (auth/mfa/recovery-code) waits on mfa_challenges; this path
proves one-time consume for an authenticated session.

delete.description: MVP device id equals session id. Revoke kills the session and all OIDC refresh for the user.

404.description: Device missing or not owned by caller.

get.summary: Lists devices for the current user.
get.description:
MVP: each active BFF session appears as a device (trusted_devices is Target schema).
deviceFingerprint is the session id hex; trust/history endpoints are not in this slice.

post.summary: Invites a username into the tenant.
post.description:
Issues a one-time invite token delivered out-of-band (Testing sink).
Does not return the plaintext token or a Host-based URL (G-AUTH-16 → ).

post.summary: Accepts an invite and creates the user.
post.description: Single-use token. Replay → 401 auth.token.invalid.

patch.summary: Renames and/or moves a group in the Host-resolved tenant.
patch.description: Omit name/parentId to leave unchanged. clearParent=true moves the group to root.

get.summary: Gets a group by id in the Host-resolved tenant.
get.description: Cross-tenant ids are indistinguishable from missing — both return 404.

404.description: Group missing or belongs to another tenant.

delete.summary: Deletes a group in the Host-resolved tenant.
delete.description: Fails with 409 when the group still has children or members.

delete.summary: Removes a user from a group in the Host-resolved tenant.

404.description: Group, user, or membership missing / other-tenant.

post.summary: Adds a user to a group in the Host-resolved tenant.
post.description: Duplicate membership → 409 group.member_already_assigned. Cross-tenant → 404.

get.summary: Lists members of a group (paged).
get.description: Query: page, page_size, search.

get.summary: Lists groups of the Host-resolved tenant (paged).
get.description: Flat list ordered by path. Query: page, page_size, search.

post.summary: Creates a group in the Host-resolved tenant.
post.description:
Name is unique per tenant. Optional parentId must belong to the same tenant.
Hierarchy uses a materialized path string (no PostgreSQL ltree in MVP).

400.description: Validation failed or tenant not resolved.

get.summary: Returns tenant admin overview counters.
get.description:
Users, active sessions, OIDC clients, and login success/failure counts for the last 24h
(from audit event_type keys). Tenant from Host only.

get.summary: Returns tenant login health and process Argon/RSS snapshot.
get.description:
Per-tenant login p95 (in-process window), 429 rate-limit and Argon busy counters,
process-wide Argon slots and WorkingSet. Tenant from Host only.

post.summary: Passwordless passkey login (not implemented in MVP).
post.description:
Returns 501 auth.mfa.webauthn_not_implemented. Login MFA remains TOTP/recovery
after password until WebAuthn lands post-MVP.

post.summary: Verifies email with a one-time token.
post.description: Burns the token. Replay / expiry / unknown → 401 auth.token.invalid (G-AUTH-18).

post.summary: Completes step-up MFA for the current session.
post.description:
Verifies enrolled TOTP and stamps sessions.step_up_verified_at.
Sensitive path prefixes require a fresh stamp within Auth:StepUp:MaxAge.

204.description: Step-up recorded on the BFF session.

post.summary: Resets password with a one-time token.
post.description:
Tenant from Host only. Burns the token (single-use). Replay / expiry / unknown → 401 auth.token.invalid.
Brute-force token submits are rate-limited (G-AUTH-15/18).

post.summary: Requests an email-verification token for a username.
post.description:
Always 202 when accepted — whether or not the username exists.
Plaintext token via delivery sink only; no Request.Host links.

202.description: Accepted; verify token sent when the user exists.

get.summary: Returns whether self-registration is enabled for the Host tenant.
get.description: No secrets. Used by Account/Admin login to show or hide Register.

post.summary: Registers a user when self-registration is enabled for the tenant.
post.description:
Tenant from Host only. Creates a normal user (no tenant_admin).
Disabled tenants return 403 auth.registration_disabled. Rate limits match login (G-AUTH-05/06).

post.summary: Requests a passwordless magic-link login email.
post.description:
Tenant from Host. Always 202 when accepted — whether or not the username exists.
Link uses Auth:SecurityToken:PublicBaseUrl (G-AUTH-16). WebAuthn stays out of scope (W-SH-01).

202.description: Accepted; email sent when the user exists and has an address.

post.summary: Redeems a magic-link token into a BFF session.
post.description: Sets __Host-clavi-session on success (same as password login). Single-use token.

post.summary: Signs out every BFF session for the current user.
post.description:
Tenant from Host only. When authenticated, revokes all active sessions for that user.
Always clears __Host-clavi-session and returns 204 — including anonymous callers (idempotent).

204.description: All sessions revoked when authenticated; cookie cleared.

post.summary: Signs out the current BFF session.
post.description:
Tenant from Host only. When a valid session cookie is present, revokes that session row server-side.
Always clears __Host-clavi-session and returns 204 — including anonymous callers (idempotent).
Full OIDC RP-Initiated Logout (id_token_hint / post_logout_redirect_uri) is deferred; use POST auth/rp-logout as the same BFF clear until then.

204.description: Session revoked when present; cookie cleared.

post.summary: RP-logout stub — revokes the current BFF session.
post.description:
Same behavior as POST auth/logout for the BFF cookie session.
Does not yet accept id_token_hint or post_logout_redirect_uri (OIDC deferred).
Always clears the session cookie and returns 204.

204.description: Session revoked when present; cookie cleared.

post.summary: Signs in with username and password.
post.description:
Tenant from Host only. On success sets HttpOnly __Host- session cookie; body is empty.
Unknown user and bad password return the same invalid_credentials ProblemDetails (G-AUTH-04).
Excess attempts return 429 auth.login.rate_limited (G-AUTH-05).
If the rate-limit store is down, login is denied with 503 (G-AUTH-06).
Access-policy Deny returns 403 policy.access_denied.

204.description: Authenticated; Set-Cookie has the BFF session token.

400.description: Validation failed or tenant not resolved.

401.description: invalid_credentials: unknown user or bad password.

403.description: policy.access_denied, or auth.cutover.required for needs_config users.

post.summary: Requests a password-reset token for a username.
post.description:
Tenant from Host only. Always returns 202 when the request is accepted — whether or not the username exists.
Plaintext token is delivered out-of-band with a link from Auth:SecurityToken:PublicBaseUrl (G-AUTH-16).

202.description: Accepted; reset token sent when the user exists.

400.description: Validation failed or tenant not resolved.

post.summary: Sets password after Keycloak cutover OIDC proof.
post.description:
Requires the BFF session cookie issued by the cutover OIDC callback.
Stores Argon2id only — never accepts a Keycloak password or ROPC.

204.description: Password stored; cutover complete; session remains valid.

401.description: Missing session or invalid cutover state.

post.summary: Proves Keycloak identity for a needs_config cutover user.
post.description:
Tenant from Host. Validates an OIDC id_token proof (never Resource Owner Password).
On success sets the BFF session cookie so the client can call set-password.

204.description: OIDC accepted; Set-Cookie has a short BFF session for set-password.

post.summary: Confirms one side of an email change.
post.description:
Burns a single-use token for the current or pending address.
When both sides are confirmed, the email is committed and all BFF sessions are revoked.

204.description: Partial confirm or completed change (sessions revoked on complete).

post.summary: Checks whether a password appears in known breach corpora.
post.description:
Uses HIBP k-anonymity (SHA-1 prefix only). When HIBP is down, falls back to the local list
and returns source=local_fallback. When both are unavailable → 503.
Does not set or change any credential.

post.summary: Changes the authenticated user's password.
post.description:
Requires a live BFF session cookie and the current password.
New password is checked against HIBP (k-anonymity) with local fallback (G-AUTH-12/13).
On success all sessions are revoked and the cookie is cleared — sign in again.

204.description: Password updated; sessions revoked; cookie cleared.

401.description: Missing session or wrong current password.

post.summary: Requests an email change with dual confirmation.
post.description:
Requires a live BFF session cookie and the current password.
Issues one-time tokens to the current and new addresses (config PublicBaseUrl links).
Email is not swapped until both tokens are confirmed (G-AUTH-17).

202.description: Accepted; confirm tokens delivered when the account has a current email.

401.description: Missing session, bad password, or auth.session.required.

post.summary: Activates break-glass admin elevation for the current BFF session.
post.description: Requires Auth:BreakGlass:Secret (≥16). Elevation expires after Auth:BreakGlass:Duration.

get.summary: Returns current break-glass status for the BFF session.

post.summary: Bootstraps the first tenant_admin with caller-chosen credentials.
post.description:
Allowed only when the Host-resolved tenant has zero users.
Prefer username+password in the JSON body (admin login UI).
Unattended scripts may omit the body and use Auth:Bootstrap env instead.

400.description: Tenant unresolved or password validation failed.

get.summary: Returns whether the first tenant_admin can be created.
get.description:
Anonymous. available=true when the Host-resolved tenant has zero users.
Credentials are chosen in the bootstrap POST body (or Auth:Bootstrap env for scripts).
Does not reveal credentials or usernames.

get.summary: Gets a webhook by id (cross-tenant → 404).

post.summary: Attempts a test delivery after SSRF re-check.
Rotates webhook HMAC secret; plaintext returned once.

get.summary: Lists webhooks for the Host-resolved tenant.

post.summary: Creates a webhook endpoint; plaintext secret returned once.

put.summary: Updates an OIDC scope in the Host-resolved tenant.

get.summary: Gets an OIDC scope by id.

delete.summary: Soft-deletes a custom OIDC scope (system scopes are immutable).

get.summary: Lists OIDC scopes of the Host-resolved tenant.

post.summary: Creates a custom OIDC scope in the Host-resolved tenant.

get.summary: GET /oidc/userinfo — Bearer access token + scoped claims.

post.summary: POST /oidc/token — single mint path (G-OIDC-01); form body only.
POST /oidc/revoke (RFC 7009). Unknown token → 200.
POST /oidc/par — Pushed Authorization Request (RFC 9126).
POST /oidc/introspect (RFC 7662).

get.summary:
GET|POST /oidc/logout — RP-Initiated Logout (G-OIDC-07).
Rejects open redirects; clears the BFF cookie on success (cookie stays in the endpoint).

post.summary:
GET|POST /oidc/logout — RP-Initiated Logout (G-OIDC-07).
Rejects open redirects; clears the BFF cookie on success (cookie stays in the endpoint).

get.summary: GET /.well-known/openid-configuration (anonymous).
GET /.well-known/jwks.json — public keys only; private material is never routed (G-OIDC-04).

post.summary: POST /oidc/device/verify — BFF subject approves/denies a user_code.
POST /oidc/device/code — Device Authorization Grant issue (RFC 8628).

get.summary:
GET /oidc/authorize — Authorization Code + mandatory PKCE (G-AUTH-01 / G-OIDC-02/03).
Subject comes from BFF session claims; no Identity module reference.

post.summary: POST /oidc/authorize — form confirm for classic consent screens (OpenAPI confirmConsent).

delete.summary: Revokes OIDC consent for one application.
delete.description:
Soft-revokes user_consents and revokes refresh tokens for that client_id.
Unknown client_id → 404.

get.summary: Lists OIDC applications the current user has consented to.

put.summary: Updates an OIDC client in the Host-resolved tenant.

get.summary: Gets an OIDC client by id in the Host-resolved tenant.

delete.summary: Soft-deletes an OIDC client in the Host-resolved tenant.

get.summary: Lists OIDC clients of the Host-resolved tenant (paged).
get.description: Query: page, page_size, search, enabled.

post.summary: Creates an OIDC client in the Host-resolved tenant.

get.summary: Gets the current pending OIDC consent request.
get.description: Bound to the BFF session. Returns 404 when no active (non-expired) pending interaction exists.

post.summary: Confirms or denies the pending OIDC consent request.
post.description:
Approved=true grants scopes and redirects to the client with an authorization code.
Approved=false clears the pending interaction and returns 403.

get.summary: Lists API keys (prefix + last4 only).

post.summary: Creates an API key; plaintext secret returned once.

get.summary: Lists append-only version snapshots for an access policy.

post.summary: Validates access-policy YAML against MVP grammar rules.

put.summary: Updates YAML, description, and priority for an access policy.

get.summary: Gets an access policy by id in the Host-resolved tenant.
Loads a persisted policy decision trace by request id.

404.description: No decision for the request id.

post.summary: Rolls an access policy back to a prior version and publishes PolicyDeployed.

get.summary: Lists access policies of the Host-resolved tenant.

post.summary: Creates a draft access policy in the Host-resolved tenant.
Evaluates active policies (or an optional YAML override) for a synthetic request.

200.description: Decision returned; optionally persisted when Persist=true.

post.summary: Deploys an access policy and appends a version snapshot.
Archives an access policy so it leaves the evaluate path.

get.summary: Verifies the Host-resolved tenant audit hash-chain.

200.description: Integrity result; IsIntact false means tamper/break detected.

get.summary: Lists newest audit entries for the Host tenant (paged).
get.description:
Returns eventType (stable key) and message localized for Accept-Language or tenant default locale.
Query: page, page_size, eventType, actorId, resourceType, from, to.

post.summary: Applies a Keycloak realm dump and returns a job id.
post.description:
Body = Keycloak realm-export JSON. Imports users with portable password digests
(Keycloak hashes preserved; progressive Argon2id rehash on next login).
Skips needs_config users and existing usernames. Authenticated callers hit step-up
on /api/v1/migration/keycloak (G-MIG-02).

post.summary: Rolls back the latest completed Keycloak apply job.
post.description: Deletes users listed in the job report importedUsernames and marks the job rolled_back. Only the latest completed apply may be rolled back (409 otherwise). Authenticated callers need fresh step-up (G-MIG-02 path prefix).

409.description: Not the latest completed apply, or already rolled back / dry-run.

get.summary: Returns migration job status and sample errors.
get.description: Tenant-scoped. Dry-run jobs are completed immediately with report counters.

404.description: Unknown job id for this tenant.

get.summary: Downloads the Keycloak dump attached to a migration job.
get.description: Requires a bound BFF session. Path is under Auth:StepUp PathPrefixes (G-MIG-02): authenticated calls without fresh step-up receive 403 step_up_required. Expired or missing dumps return 404.

404.description: Unknown job, expired dump, or no dump attached.

post.summary: Runs a Keycloak import dry-run and returns a job id.
post.description:
Body = Keycloak realm-export JSON. Parses users/clients and stores a completed job
with counters and sample issue codes. Does not write clavi_identity.users.

get.summary: Cutover Live Board: apply stats, pending cutover, login error rate, optional KC probe.
get.description:
Tenant-scoped. Requires step-up when authenticated (migration prefix).
Keycloak probe uses Migration:KeycloakDualRun:BaseUrl when set.

post.summary: Converts Keycloak authenticationFlows into a Clavi Policy YAML draft.
post.description:
Body = realm-export JSON (or authenticationFlows array). Query ?alias=browser selects a flow.
Returns draft YAML + coverage % — never deploys the policy.

get.summary: Returns the work-item list from the latest Keycloak theme import.

200.description: Array of work-item strings (empty when no import yet).

post.summary: Publishes an imported Keycloak theme as the active login skin.
post.description: Optional JSON body { contentHash }. When omitted, uses the latest import. Login then serves /themes/{tenant}/{hash}/login/login.html via GET /login.

400.description: No import to publish, or tenant unresolved.

get.summary: Serves a theme preview file under a content-hash directory.
get.description: Path must resolve under {root}/{tenant}/{hash}/. Traversal, absolute paths, or tenant mismatch → 404.

404.description: Missing, unsafe path, or wrong tenant.

get.summary: Serves the published login page HTML for the Host tenant.
get.description: Uses active theme login/login.html when published; otherwise a default shell.

post.summary: Imports a Keycloak theme ZIP and returns preview paths plus a work-item list.
post.description: MVP FreeMarker→HTML preview (honest 40–60%). Files land under /themes/{tenant}/{hash}/ (G-PATH-01). Raw application/zip body.

400.description: Invalid ZIP, too large, or unsafe entry paths.

get.summary: Returns the active published theme metadata.

put.summary: Creates or updates a notification template.

get.summary: Lists notification templates for the tenant.

post.summary: Previews a notification template without sending.

ClaviServerEndpointsSystemTenantProbeRes.description: Resolved-tenant snapshot for the probe endpoint.

title.default: One or more validation errors occurred.

ClaviSharedContractsPagingPagedListOfUse.description: OpenAPI PagedResult: items + total + page + pageSize.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsUsersCreate.description: Create-user body. Tenant is never accepted here — Host/path only.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsTenantsTena.description: Public tenant catalog DTO — no secrets.

ClaviSharedContractsPagingPagedListOfTen.description: OpenAPI PagedResult: items + total + page + pageSize.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsTenantsTena.description: Inbound tenant config body (partial sections allowed; omitted fields keep defaults).

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsAuthCheckBr.description: Standalone breach-check body (does not change credentials).

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsSecurityIso.description: POST body: peer slug to probe against.

ClaviSharedContractsPagingPagedListOfMeS.description: OpenAPI PagedResult: items + total + page + pageSize.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsMeMeSession.description: Self-service session row (MVP: no ip/userAgent columns yet).

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsMeMeProfile.description: Self-service profile DTO — no secrets; includes admin nav capabilities.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsMeMfaTotpVe.description: TOTP code for an already-enrolled method.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsMeMfaTotpSe.description: One-time TOTP enroll material for the authenticator app.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsMeMfaTotpCo.description: Plaintext recovery codes returned once after TOTP confirm (G-AUTH-11).
First TOTP code that activates enrollment.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsMeMfaRecove.description: How many unused recovery codes remain (plaintext never returned).
Fresh plaintext batch after regenerate — shown once.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsMeMeDeviceR.description:
Device DTO backed by an active session id (MVP stand-in for trusted_devices).
DeviceFingerprint is the session id hex — stable per session row.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsInvitations.description: Invite body — target username (no email channel yet).
Accept-invite body — token + password for the new user.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsGroupsPatch.description: Patch group body — omit fields to leave unchanged; clearParent moves to root.

ClaviSharedContractsPagingPagedListOfGro.description: OpenAPI PagedResult: items + total + page + pageSize.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsGroupsCreat.description: Create-group body. Tenant is Host/path only.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsAuthResetPa.description: Reset-password body — plaintext token + new password.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsAuthLoginLo.description: Login body. Tenant comes from Host/path only.

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsAuthForgotP.description: Forgot-password body — username only (no email channel yet).

ClaviModulesIdentityEndpointsAuthCutover.description: Forced password after Keycloak cutover OIDC proof.
